name: sleeve-lock-leather
note: 10 Signature Sleeve Lock, v002 sketch (references/packaging/10_sleeve_lock_v002.png, 2026-11-12): 100 mm cube, lift-off lid ('lift along shape'). The seam is level at seam_side_z on the sides and back and drops in a V across the front to seam_low_z at the centre. Along the seam a `reveal` gap shows the lid's velvet lining, which hangs below the lid as a skirt (inset from the faces, half sizes `skirt`) down to the base rim; inside it a thick velvet collar on the base rises collar_rise above the seam; no gold beads along the seam (bead_height 0 since v004). A strap runs up the front, over the lid and down the back; a plain gold clasp on the lid sits on the strap at the V tip, across the reveal. Inside the collar a velvet ring pad of two rounded rolls. The perhaps wordmark in gold foil on the lid ceiling. Leather look (v005 brief, 2026-11-12): fine-grain matte leather in forest green #123B2D outside and on the strap, muted lavender suede #C3A6CD lining (collar, skirt, cushion, lid inside) showing in a 4 mm reveal along the V seam, a smaller thinner brushed champagne-gold clasp #C3AA7C, a softer rounded cushion, and a small tone-on-tone lavender perhaps wordmark raised on the lid ceiling. v006: deep purple leather (#3A1F4D) outside and on the strap, champagne-gold diamond clasp (12.5 mm diagonals, 2.4 mm deep, faceted crown). v007: dark brown grained leather (designer photo, leather.designer-brown) outside and on the strap, interior suede a step lighter brown (#5A3E2C). v008: exterior is the designer rib jacquard recoloured to bottle green #263830 (45 mm tile), strap smooth leather in that green 15 % darker; interior as v007. v011: no strap (the band over the top and front is gone); the diamond clasp sits straight on the lid at the V tip.

materials.note: glTF-safe stand-ins for the GLB (very dark bottle-green thin rib jacquard colour map, darker green strap, brown suede as v009, champagne gold); renders swap in config/presets/box_sleeve_lock_v010_look.json.
